# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to *Math 401: Non-Riemannian Hypersquares*! These notes follow the course day by day. The homework, practice exams and syllabus are in the appendices, and every theorem, exercise and exam question is linked: @thm-pythagoras is a click away from anywhere in the course.

The website and the PDF (the download button in the sidebar) are made from the same files, so they always agree.

::: {.block-info}
::: {.block-header}
About this template
:::
This is a sample course, made up to show what the template can do. Look for:

+ theorems, examples and proofs in the notes, with a table in @sec-polytopes and colored blocks in @sec-hypersquares;
+ a math macro defined by the course itself, $\Hsq{n}$, next to ones that come with the template, like $\Rb^n$;
+ homework with solutions that only the instructor build shows (@exr-hypotenuse-calculation);
+ a practice exam whose solutions open with a click online but stay out of the PDF, and a midterm and quiz with automatic grade tables (instructor build only);
+ a syllabus filled in from `_variables.yml`.

Delete this block when you make the course your own.
:::
